quality_notes: 2024 observed baseline and 2025–2034 RUPTL planned additions must be presented in different series.
Installed MVA is equipment nameplate, not MW of unused firm capacity.
2024 regional units and province labels are different geographic scopes; do not attribute UIT totals to a province.
PLN Batam subsidiary assets and provincial UID assets should not be merged without an independently documented scope reconciliation.
Regional firm N-1 headroom, grid queue and project connection status are unavailable in this data.
